name: subterfuge-reignited
description: A web-based clone of the strategy game Subterfuge.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @subterfuge/engine && npm run build -w @subterfuge/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @subterfuge/engine && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @subterfuge/engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
